audioFollowUp: vrekt-audio-file-2026-10-18.json repairs the wrong SoundKitEntry metadata descriptor, executes the native file link and fully reads/decodes client FileDataID1519112. The historical reader limitation below is resolved; actual Player/client playback remains pending.

status: Repaired completion/direct-reward admission when a world-quest rotation is missing, expired or already personally rewarded. Native completion-state persistence and native Vrekt outro execution pass the bounded checks below. Actual item delivery and Player/client playback are not claimed verified.
finding: RewardQuest formerly removed the task and dispatched its reward spell even when GetWorldQuest returned null. The dynamic reward and m_worldquests completion record are inside that lookup's conditional block and were skipped. GetWorldQuest itself does not check ResetTime. CompleteQuest also marked complete before any rotation check. This is a source/function-fixture finding, not a reported client observation.

implementation.admission: Player::CanRewardWorldQuest permits ordinary quests unchanged. World/emissary quests require an active record, its reward template, ResetTime strictly after GameTime and no unexpired personal completion. Exact expiry is rejected; an expired old personal completion does not block a later active rotation.
implementation.entryPoints: CompleteQuest checks before writing quest status/slot state or invoking completion scripts. RewardQuest checks again at its direct entry before consuming objectives, giving static/dynamic rewards, removing the task, writing completion or casting the outro. This covers automatic tasks and direct callers. Existing CanCompleteQuest/CanRewardQuest objective/turn-in predicates remain unchanged; their positive result is not a promise the rotation will still be available at execution time.
implementation.scope: Shared world/emissary reward safety, not a Vrekt entry whitelist. No changes to scheduler selection, its inherited five-minute reset policy, rewards, timers, unlocks, personal character state or database schema. No fabricated missing rotation or completion record.
